answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond tied to a hash-chained history of verified work: every completed job appends a signed receipt from an independent client, and the bond for each new identity rises steeply when registrations share the same hardware and payment fingerprint. One fake gives a weak signal, but a tide of fresh accounts with no velvet-smooth record of real clients must each pay a bigger bond, so one extra identity costs a full extra bond plus months of genuine client receipts it cannot forge for itself.
